༄༅/khro bo chen po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgo nas rnal 'byor pa rang gi grib bsal ba'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅/ khro bo chen po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgo nas rnal 'byor pa rang gi grib bsal ba'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// yi dam sme brtsegs khro bo dang*// mkha' 'gro sme brtsegs ma la 'dud// gzhan gyi grib sel logs su bstan// rnal 'byor rang gi grib sel ni// zan ni gtsang ma gcig la ni// mchod rten nag po'i phyogs bzhi ru// mdun sbrul g.yas sbal rgyab tu bya// g.yon du phag nag gzugs bya'o// 'brang rgyas phyed dkar phyed nag dang*// gtsang ma'i snod du changs bu gsum// gtor chung nywa yus brgyan byas bzhag /rang gi srin lag g.yon pa la// skud nag phyir log bkal ba dkris// gdan la 'dug ste 'di skad do// deng nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// rdo rje sems dpa' khro bo sme ba brtsegs/ khro mo sme brtsegs rnams la skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i sdig ltung grib dang sdug bsngal kun// bsal nas dag pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gi spyi bor zla steng hūm̐ yig las// 'od 'phros don gnyis byas nas 'dus pa las// bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' kun da'i mdog /mtshan dpe rab rdzogs dar dang rin chen brgyan// rdo rje dril 'dzin phyed skyil bzhugs pa yi// gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros pas// rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam chos skyong rnams// bu yug 'tshub bzhin byon nas sku la thim// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor// bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs sdig sgrib dag par gyur// oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mchod rten bran/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ mchod rten stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng*// hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'od du zhu ba las/ khro bo sme brtsegs dbu dgu mdung thabs brtsegs// sku mdog dug chen ha la bzhin du gnag /phyag bzhi zhabs bzhi 'byung bzhi'i gdan la bzhugs// g.yas kyi dang pos me dkyil gru gsum bag chags sreg

/'og mas sa dkyil gru bzhi bag chags gnon// g.yon pas chu dkyil zlum pos bag chags bkru// 'og mas rlung dkyil zla gam bag chags gtor// sku la dug gi me dpung sngo dmar 'bar// gdan mtshams phyogs bzhir dug gsum ma rig pa'i// ngo bo bya sbrul phag gsum sbal nag bcas// gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ dang mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa// spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur// spro na spyan 'dren ma lus sems can sogs bya'o// oṃ bhur khung dhis sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rgyas par rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs gang 'os dang bstun/ oṃ bhur khung dhis arghaṃ sogs nas shabda āḥhūm̐/ de nas gtor ma changs bu la chu gtsang bran la/ oṃ āḥbighnāṃ sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod// yangs shing rgya che'i nang du khaṃ nag po// zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho nag por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ khro bo'i ljags rtse 'od zer sbu gu yis// bdud rtsi gsol bas tshims shing dgyes par gyur// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ nyer gcig brjod la gtor ma changs bu mchod rten du 'bul/ de nas srin mdzub la dkris pa'i skud pa nag po'i sne nas lag g.yas kyis bzung la/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya brjod cing mchod rten la bskor ba gcig byas te/ rang gi sdig sgrib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad 'od nag po'i rnam par thon/ skud pa 'di la thim pa nyid du gyur/ ces mdud pa gcig bya/ de lta bu gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig bya'o// de nas skud pa mchod rten gyi dbu la btags nas/ bdag gi bag chags sdig sgrib nyams chag dang*// phrag dog mi gtsang grib kyis gos pa rnams// thams cad khro bo khyod la mchod par 'bul// sku gsung thugs rgyud mnyes shing thugs dam bskangs// sku lus gzi mdangs rgyas par mdzad du gsol//

de nas 'brang rgyas dkar nag gris bgos la/ dkar po yar bzhag /nag po mchod rten mdun du bzhag la bran nas/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ khro bo khro mo chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// 'khor dang bcas pa gsan cing dgongs su gsol// nyams dang dri ma'i tshogs rnams byang bar mdzod// nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa'i skong ba byas// nyams pa snod med rnams la chos bshad byas// nyams pa'i zas zos nyams pa'i skom 'thungs dang*// nyams pa can dang gtam 'dres kha rlangs 'dres// nyams pa can dang phyag dang gos stan 'dres// nyams grib skyon gyur rme rmugs nal gsum dang*// ro bag sme btsog sdig sgrib la sogs te// bag chags byur gyis gos pa'i nyes pa yis// bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ khro bo khro mo chos skyong srung ma yi// thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis dang*// rme btsog dri ma'i tshogs kyis gos gyur pa/ khyed kyi thugs dgongs nam mkha' lta bu la// mthol zhing bshags so gnong zhing 'gyod lags pas// dag cing byang nas nyams grib med par mdzod// nyams grib nad gdon thams cad dag nas kyang*// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis// bdag cag lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs// rang gi gti mug las gyur pa'i grib dang sdig sgrib thams cad phag la thim par bsam la/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba lnga 'dus phung po la// nyon mongs sgrib pa'i bag chags kyis// gos par gyur pa'i dri ma rnams// gti mug phag la thim gyur cig /oṃ ma hā ma dhā li ka ye swā hā/ rang gi zhe sdang las gyur pa'i grib dang sdig sgrib thams cad sbrul la thim par bsgom la/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba lnga 'dus phung po la// nyon mongs sgrib pa'i bag chags kyis// gos par gyur pa'i dri ma rnams// zhe sdang sbrul la thim gyur cig /oṃ ma ma kro ta kro ta ye swā hā/ rang gi 'dod chags las gyur pa'i grib dang sdig sgrib thams cad bya la thim par

bsgom la/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba lnga 'dus phung po la// nyon mongs sgrib pa'i bag chags kyis// gos par gyur pa'i dri ma rnams// 'dod chags bya la thim gyur cig /oṃ ma hā ki li ki li sngo ta ye swā hā/ rang gi ma rig pa'i las las gyur pa'i grib dang sdig sgrib thams cad sbal pa la thim par bsgom la/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba lnga 'dus phung po la// nyon mongs sgrib pa'i bag chags kyis// gos par gyur pa'i dri ma rnams// ma rig sbal pa 'di la thim gyur cig /oṃ ma ma raṃ raṃ ye swā hā/ de ltar ma rig pa dang dug gsum so so'i gzugs la thim pa de khro bo la mthun rdzas su 'bul bas mnyes par bsgom la/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba lnga 'dus phung po la// byur dang nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams/ khro chen sme ba brtsegs pa la// mchod par 'bul bas dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ma ma su su ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma raṃ raṃ ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma kar kar ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ma chur chur ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ hūm̐/ rang gi spyi bo'i rdor sems sku lus las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab tshangs bug nas zhugs te// bdud rtsis lus gang lus ngag yid gsum gyi// sdig sgrib nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang ba// thams cad sol khu'i rnam par lus las thon// sme ba brtsegs la mchod pa'i tshul du 'bul/ khro bo shin tu dgyes nas gzi mdangs 'bar// mthu nus stobs rtsal phun sum tshogs par gyur// oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ oṃ bhur kuṃ ma hā pra mā na ye bhurtsi bhurki bi ma le u tsuṣma ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces khro bo sme brtsegs kyi sngags lan gsum dang*/ oṃ ghar khaṃ 'dzir khaṃ u tsuṣma kro ta phaṭa swā hā/ zhes khro mo sme brtsegs kyi sngags lan gsum rnams brjod cing*/ mchod rten gyi steng du khrus byas la/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig

/gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul mthol lo bshags// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs// thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol// de skad gsol ba btab pa yis// rdo rje sems dpa' 'od zhu nas// bdag la thim pas bdag nyid ni// yi dam lha yi skur gsal gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas mchod rten gtor ma sogs// grong khyer gyi ni lho phyogs sam/ khang pa mi mngon sa ru ni// rol mo dang bcas bskyal nas kyang*// oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐/ zhes sogs mtshams bcad srung 'khor bsgom// dper na rma byas dug 'thung na// sgro la mdongs re 'byung ba yin// de bzhin sme brtsegs grib sogs kyis// mchod na sku lus gzi mdangs rgyas// rang gi nyams grib dag pa yin// sme brtsegs grib sel zab mo 'di// gzhung gi 'khrugs bsal lag len bsres// sme brtsegs bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rā ga'i ming can de yis bris// nyes bshags dge bas sgrib dag shog /bha wantu/// /
